purpose: Four static homepage composition previews for user selection; not implemented animation.

variants.name: 层叠薄膜
variants.prompt: Edit the supplied ORIGINAL ElseLife homepage screenshot to produce one clearly distinct homepage hero CONCEPT MOCKUP. Preserve the exact logo, navigation, all Chinese text including “世界之外，另有人生。”, typography, buttons, ivory background, page spacing and footer. Only replace the original single funnel artwork on the right. The user's decisive constraints: SMALLER and MUCH LESS FLASHY. The artwork must be a quiet secondary accent, surrounded by generous uninterrupted ivory whitespace. At the reference resolution 1440x900, the ENTIRE artwork should fit inside a compact box approximately 350 pixels wide by 300 pixels high, centered at x=1080,y=460 (75% width,51% height). Keep every component between 61% and 89% of page width, 30% and 72% of page height. Do not enlarge it to fill the right column. Main individual shapes should be roughly 80-150 pixels across. No component touches page edges or text. Restrained very thin desaturated gray-violet lines with at most a tiny pale teal accent. The density and contrast must let the title remain the strongest element. No rainbow, bloom, glitter, stars, galaxy textures, thick glowing ribbons, spacecraft, sci-fi machinery, dramatic dark backgrounds, large black centers, labels or annotations. These are still-frame visual direction studies for a future animation; preserve all existing page copy and controls. Keep original aspect ratio. Direction A — SPARSE WIREFRAME MEMBRANES. Three small airy undulating spacetime sheets at different depths, with delicate square-mesh contour wireframes, each locally curving inward into a small throat. Foreground sheet modestly larger, two sheets recede upward-left. Carefully differentiate their rotations and curvature. Each sheet has roughly 15-20 smooth grid lines, no dense texture. Exactly two thin bundled curved threads connect the throat of one membrane to another. One minuscule light bead indicates passage. The effect is a restrained architectural wireframe sculpture, soft and precise. Each membrane remains mostly empty space. All three sheets and both connections together occupy only the specified compact box. Avoid the huge foreground funnel from earlier designs.
